scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn trainscanner.main:app --reload --port ${API_PORT:-8100}
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.gen:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -c "import json;from trainscanner.main import app;print(json.dumps(app.openapi(),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))" > ../../contracts/openapi.json
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.check: npm run lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q && cd ../.. && npm run build
